about.title: About me
text: I'm a software developer, and what I like building most are tools that make other people's work easier. That's why I founded useblocks, where I helped build Sphinx-Needs and many other docs-as-code tools as team lead – they run in large engineering projects today. These days I support useblocks as an advisor.
What drives me is how large, distributed teams keep track – of requirements, tests, decisions and the knowledge in between. My tools are small and focused: each one solves exactly one problem.

views.title: Views
views.lead: Good views make complex relations clear in seconds; bad ones hide them. I care about how to show information, data structures and workflows from large projects so that people sense problems instead of having to read them.

views.netHint: Drag to turn the network, click a roll to see it large. Hover over a roll to see its lowest score. The data is an example.
views.netAlt: 3D network of 48 pull requests in four layers – app, service, library, platform –, each a small quality roll, connected by their dependencies. Three of them are red and orange in many places.
